children: none, because the change is one predicate at one chokepoint (_post, which all three verbs call) plus its proofs; the two things it could have been split into — the refusal and a retry-until-loaded — are not siblings, because the retry is a policy question nobody has asked for and build-minimal says the refusal comes first and the retry grows against a measured need.

questions.a: THE 200 IS NOT A LIE AND MUST NOT BE TREATED AS ONE. ollama answers 200 because the request was accepted and the stream was opened; the frame is a legitimate non-final chunk that a STREAMING client would read and keep reading. The defect is entirely on our side: we asked for stream:False and then read a non-final frame as if it were the answer. A future reader tempted to file this as 'hex is broken' should read the raw body — it says done:false, which is exactly what it means.

num_ctx IS NOT THE DISCRIMINATOR AND NEITHER IS THE TIMEOUT — both were live hypotheses tonight and both are dead. Six consecutive successes at num_ctx 8192, 32768 and 81920 once the model is up; the empty frame arrives in 0.1s against a 120.0s bound, three orders of magnitude inside it, and the transport never raised. Recorded because both are the obvious next guesses and re-deriving a settled answer is Law 1's defect.

THE CHECK GOES AT _post, NOT IN THE CHAT BRANCH, AND THE REASON IS ABOUT EVIDENCE RATHER THAN TIDINESS. The empty frame was measured on /api/chat only, n=6. Whether /api/generate does the same while loading is unmeasured. A per-branch fix would be three copies of a claim measured once; the chokepoint fix keys on a property of the RESPONSE that holds for any verb, so the unmeasured verbs are covered without pretending they were measured.

host.py's validated_messages docstring says 'On Hex a cold qwen3-coder:30b load is ~18s (measured 2026-08-16)'. Tonight's cold load-and-answer at num_ctx 81920 measured 131.5s total_duration (load_duration 132ms, prompt_eval 468ms, eval 314ms — the balance is KV allocation). The docstring does not record what num_ctx its 18s was taken at, which is the defect in it: a measurement stored without the parameter it depends on becomes folklore the moment the parameter moves. Not fixed by this ticket; named so the next reader does not trust the 18s.

watchme.trigger: each ask recorded by inference_domain — the probe reads the domain's own ask log, so it fires on the traffic that already exists rather than on a clock
watchme.enough: enough when the refusal has fired at least once on live traffic AND no successful ask in the same log was ever refused by it — a guard that has never bitten is unproven, and a guard that bites a good answer is worse than the fault it replaced
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier: the count of non-final refusals, the count of good asks passed, and the count of HostUnmetered raised after the change (which should be raised only by genuinely counterless FINAL answers)
watchme.consumer: whoever next debugs a failed drive — the misdiagnosis this ticket exists to stop cost one voyage a false sentence in an append-only history
